title: Heat Capacity Analysis — Charcoal
description: Bomb-calorimeter determination of the specific and molar heat capacity of activated coconut charcoal.

userForm.description: Details of the charcoal specimen submitted for analysis.

template:
Sample {{sample_id}} — {{sample_source}} — was analysed on {{analysis_date}} by {{analyst_name}} ({{lab_id}}) using a {{instrument}} following {{method_ref}}.

A specimen of {{sample_mass}} g was combusted under pure oxygen at 25 atm. Temperature rose from {{temperature_initial}} °C to {{temperature_final}} °C, giving ΔT = {{delta_T}} °C. Applying the calorimeter constant of {{calorimeter_constant}} J/°C:

  Q  =  C × ΔT  =  {{calorimeter_constant}} × {{delta_T}}  =  {{heat_released}} J

Specific heat capacity  =  Q / m  =  {{specific_heat}} J/g
Molar heat capacity (M = 12.011 g/mol)  =  {{molar_heat_capacity}} J/mol

The result agrees with published values for activated charcoal (420–550 J/mol range) and confirms sample purity. No anomalous exotherms were detected during the run.
